Other Labels: White Rose Millie May View Now Welcome to White Studio Where Bridal Dreams Take Shape At White Studio London, we are dedicated to redefining bridal fashion with modern, chic, and affordable wedding dresses. With 28 years of experience in garment making, we proudly serve as a sister brand of White Rose Bridal. Our collection features high-quality gowns that embody elegance and style without the designer price tag. White Studio London caters to the trendy, modern bride seeking chic and structured wedding dresses at accessible prices. Every gown is crafted with love in our in-house factory, allowing us to maintain the highest standards of craftsmanship. We specialize in curve-size wedding gowns, ensuring every bride can find her perfect fit. Your bridal gown should be as unique and special as you are, and our curve-size collection offers exquisite styles that celebrate your beauty. With fresh, on-trend designs and customization options, we strive to make luxury bridalwear attainable for every bride. Find a Boutique Discover your perfect gown at a boutique near you. Find elegance, grace, and your dream dress with our exclusive locations. Find Now White Studio White Studio Signature White Studio Curve Our dresses are designed with every type of bride in mind, from classic and timeless to modern and unique. We have carefully curated our collection to ensure that every bride finds the dress of her dreams. Browse Collection Introducing White Studio Signature, our newest collection designed for the fashion-forward bride who seeks modern elegance and distinctive style. This collection blends high-end designer elements with contemporary trends, offering bold silhouettes, intricate details, and cutting-edge fabrics. White Studio Signature is for the bride who wants her gown to be a statement piece, reflecting her individuality and sophisticated taste. Each dress is a work of art, carefully crafted to embody the perfect balance of innovation and timeless beauty. Browse Collection Your bridal gown should be as unique and special as you, now plus size brides can look no further than our unique designer plus size wedding dress collection. As part of our White Rose Bridal family of brands, we uphold our dedication to crafting high-quality wedding dresses while curating our most affordable collection. Ensuring every bride discovers their dream gown without compromise, we believe luxury should be within everyone`s reach.
